entries.title: High Beech, Loughton water mains replacement
entries.body: A roughly 19km, three-year mains replacement across more than 60 roads in Loughton. Streets already finished this year: Queens Road, Spareleaze Hill, Hillyfields, Woodbury Hill, Rectory Lane. Streets with work underway or starting around now: Traps Hill (Jun-Dec 2026), Kings Hill (Sep-Nov 2026), Carroll Hill (Sep-Dec 2026), Hillcroft (Oct-Dec 2026). England's Lane and Staples Road are scheduled Aug 2026-Jul 2027.
entries.reverificationNote: Street-by-street dates are from June 2026 MP correspondence, not Thames Water's own live schedule -- confirm against the project page before quoting a specific street/date in a report.

entries.title: Bakers Lane / Cottis Lane, Epping carriageway improvements
entries.body: Multi-phase carriageway reconstruction near Bakers Lane / Cottis Lane, Epping, with signed diversions via St John's Road, Coronation Hill and Lincolns Field. A July 2026 residents' letter put final surfacing around 26 July 2026 (subject to change), but no later update was found -- status as of October 2026 is unconfirmed.
entries.reverificationNote: No update found after the July 2026 residents' letter. Check https://www.essexhighways.org/bakers-lane-epping for the current position before reporting this as open or closed.
